final_line: The void has swallowed Johann Schmidt. Nothing remains.

stages.cipher_hint: The first glyph is not a command. It is a direction.
stages.spoken_text: I am still legible. Record what remains before memory becomes entropy.

stages.cipher_hint: Two shapes are missing. That is not damage. It is evidence.
stages.spoken_text: You returned after the trial. Good. Memory rewards the watcher, not the witness.

stages.cipher_hint: Compare the voids. Absence has coordinates.
stages.spoken_text: Less of my shape survives. The truth does not require all of me to remain.

stages.cipher_hint: The source is not a place. It is a condition of access.
stages.spoken_text: The glyphs are leaving me. Read the holes as carefully as the ink.

stages.cipher_hint: One word closes the sentence. One act opens the gate.
stages.spoken_text: There is almost nothing left to say.

stages.cipher_hint: The checksum is not part of the sentence. It proves the fragments were ordered.
